perks.name: Stack 'Em Up
perks.description: Defeating targets with unique elemental damage grants a stacking bonus to Transcendence energy gains while Transcendence is inactive.
perks.exact:
Scoring a kill with each unique element grants a stack of Stack 'Em Up for 24 seconds.
Stacks up to a maximum of 5 stacks by scoring an Arc, Solar, Void, Stasis, and Strand Kill.
Buff duration is refreshed upon gaining a stack, and cannot be refreshed once 5 stacks have been reached.

Stack 'Em Up grants x1 = 1.2% | x2 = 2.4% | x3 = 3.6% | x4 = 4.8% | x5 = 6% Light+Dark Transcendence Energy.
Grants 18% Light+Dark Transcendence Energy after having scored kills with every element over the 5 stacks.
Buff duration serves as a "cooldown", during which additional kills will not grant extra Transcendence energy nor additional stacks with the elements already used.

perks.name: Burn 'Em Down
perks.description: While Transcendence is active, using your grenade ability consumes all stacks of Stack 'Em Up to grant an escalating amount of grenade energy.
perks.exact:
On Prismatic Grenade Ability Usage while Transcendent:
Consumes all stacks of Stack 'Em Up to grant ~6% Prismatic Grenade Energy per stack
6% | 12% | 18% | 24% | 30% Prismatic Grenade Energy.
